content: Bhawine tee Naga
Kasiimpo atokamatamo saangu tanda momaoge i laiana: Samia bhawine apobhajuaka matana eo, tee o bula amembali polandakana aena, tee sapulu rua angu kalipopo amembali mahakota i bhaana.
Bhawine incia sumai tangasaana abhawa-bhawa, tee roonamo akawamo wakutuuna to akoana incia apekee roonamo anamisi kapii.
Kasiimpo atokamatamo uka o tanda mosagaanana i laiana: Dhaangia sambaa o naga mokowaranaana maleʼi, bhaana pitu angu, tanduna sapulu angu. I bhawona bhaana dhaangia pitu angu o mahakotana.

Lencina naga sumai asoro saidhepo talu pulu talu parasee kalipopo minaaka i manga kalipopo i laiana, kasiimpo atudhaakea i dunia. Naga sumai akakaro i aroana bhawine bhemokoanana sumai mamudhaakana amembali adhoku o anaana bhawine sumai wakutuuna anaana sumai alaahiri.
Bhawine sumai apalaahiri samia ana umane bhemoparintangina bhari-bharia lipu tee katuko ase. Maka o anana sumai atoala madhei minaaka i bhawine sumai tee abhawea i Aulataʼala i aroana kauncuramakana.
Sabutuna o bhawine sumai apalai i tana matuu, i tampa mopadhana ipasadiaakana Aulataʼala to incia. Iwe sumai incia atodhambaaka 1.260 eo kangengena.
Naga Atotalo
Kasiimpo adhaangiamo potimbea i sorogaa. Mikhael tee manga malaaʼekatina apotimbe abhali naga sumai, tee o naga sumai uka apoose tee manga malaaʼekatina abhali Mikhael.
Maka o naga tee manga malaaʼekatina ataloa Mikhael, sumaimo manga incia atopadhencu minaaka i sorogaa tee indamo amembali ambuli iwe sumai.
Naga maoge sumai siitumo o ulo
modhaangiana minaaka i zamani momangenge mokosaroakana Ibilisi tee Seetani mopasaladhalana bhari-bharia miana dunia sumai atopadhencu tee atotudhaaka i dunia apoose tee manga malaaʼekatina.
Laguna Mokanana
Kasiimpo kurango uka suara momakaa i sorogaa mopogauna,

content.text: "Sii-sii akawamo kasalaamati, kuasa, tee pamarintana Aulataʼalata,
tee kuasana Al Masi mopadhana ilantina Aulataʼala to moparintana dunia sii.
malo tee eo i aroana Aulataʼalata,
tee kasakusii mobanara ipakawaakana manga incia.
Maka ucilakamo ingkomiu, e alamu tee tawo,
roonamo incia amataumea ande o wakutuuna amakasumo."

content: Naga Apajere Bhawine Sumai
Wakutuuna naga sumai amataua ande incia atobhanakamo i dunia, incia apepuumo apajere bhawine mopalaahirina ana umane sumai.

Maka roonamo bhawine sumai adhawua sapasa panina manu-manu, mboomo panina bunia momaoge, mamudhaakana incia amembali apolaka i tampana i tana matuu, to atodhambaaka kangengena talu tao satanga, tee amaridho minaaka i ulo sumai.
Sabutuna o ulo sumai, siitumo o naga, apalimba uwe minaaka i ngangana, tee o uwe sumai asiwulu mboomo umala i totona bhawine sumai, mamudhaakana o bhawine sumai apaampe.
Maka o tana aumba aago bhawine sumai. Tana aponganga kasiimpo adhoku uwe molimbana minaaka i ngangana naga sumai.

Naga sumai aʼamaramo mpuu tee bhawine sumai, kasiimpo incia alingka ahumbuni bhilaana siwuluna bhawine sumai, siitumo bhari-bharia mia motaʼatina i parintana Aulataʼala, tee modhawuna kasakusiina to Isa.
Kasiimpo naga sumai akabhale-bhale i bhiwina tawo.

footnotes.text: ulo modhaangiana minaaka i zamani momangenge: Ulo incia sii isarongiaka Ibilisi tee mowujuna Adamu tee Hawa i Inawuna Eden to apewauaka dosa. Kamata Bhaa. 3:1-6.
